qgn2n6fq.baseName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine Half - Warm White Lights
qgn2n6fq.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine Half - Warm White Lights
qgn2n6fq.sourceDescription: Bring a warm festive glow to your home with the stunning 7ft Pre-lit Wildhorn Pine Half Tree. Its half-tree design combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 250 multi-function warm white LED lights and a generous front profile. Measuring 120cm wide and 70cm deep, it sits neatly against a wall or in a corner, leaving more room for your Christmas celebrations. Broad lower branches and a classic, tapered shape create a full front display in rooms where floor space is limited. Short-cut pine needle outer branches and inner PVC tips add depth and fullness. Natural green shades and subtle brown detailing create a lovely backdrop for decorations. The fitted warm white LEDs highlight the foliage, with multiple lighting effects to suit your festive display. The tree comes in three sections, with flexible branches for easy shaping and a supportive metal stand. For the best results, spread the inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles. Designed for indoor use only, with Christmas Tree World's 10-year foliage and branch guarantee and a 1-year guarantee on the lights. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. These timeless, stylish baubles create a chic and elegant festive display, and their champagne gold tones blend effortlessly with traditional or contemporary décor. The multi-finish design enhances the visual appeal of your tree, with a luxurious look that stands out in any setting. Their durable construction means they can be enjoyed year after year, so they are a lasting addition to your festive decorations.
